name: Superr MCP
description:
SuperrPaper is a handwriting-first notebook app for iPad. There is no keyboard by design, so everything on a page was written with an Apple Pencil or spoken aloud.

This connector lets Claude work with those notebooks. It can browse folders and notebooks, read what is actually on a page (handwriting, typeset documents, notes, cards, templates and shapes), and write back. Claude can add a well-typeset document, place notes or shapes beside existing handwriting, import an article into a notebook, and reorganise or remove pages.

Anything Claude writes lands on the person's real page and syncs to their iPad. The connector reaches only that person's own notebooks and the ones already shared with them.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Superr MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Superr MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.superr.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Superr MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Superr MCP lists 15 MCP tools, including add_element, browse, create_document, create_page, create_resource, delete_page, delete_resource, edit_document, edit_element, import_document, move_page, and read_pages.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Superr MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Superr MCP in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Superr MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Superr MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Superr MCP is developed by Superr. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
